violated_contract: A value handed to an HTTP client's automatic param/body encoder must be raw. Manually percent-encoding it first, then passing it through the client's own encoder, encodes reserved characters like "+" a second time and changes what the receiving server parses.
canonical_prevention: Build request values unencoded and let exactly one layer -- the HTTP client's params/body encoder -- perform encoding. Prove it with a test that constructs the real request object the code path sends and asserts the final wire-encoded string, not the pre-client intermediate value.
